<!-- Say what changes and why. See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

- [ ] `just ci` passes, or the recipes this change touches do, and I say which.
- [ ] A language change cites its RFC and changes the Reference's paragraphs first.
- [ ] Tests expect what the Reference says, not what an implementation printed.
- [ ] A file in `changes/` says what this does for a user, or the label `no-changes-file` applies.
- [ ] If an AI tool wrote much of this change, I say which and what I checked.
